## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      5 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 14.05.2026 - 25.06.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _bshwbdidn_, 16.06.2026, 1/5: "Ever since ABC bought out trainerize it’s been downhill from there They push the glitz and glam upgrades and AI tools (which quite frankly are of no real use for a non cookie cutter coaching service) But then have absolutely zero interest in making sure their platform actually works. Always glitched, always app crashes and never any true accountability I’ve been on multiple calls and email exchanges to be reassured that things would get better. It’s been over a year of this now and my patience is gone. I’ll be transferring my client base elsewhere and would not recommend this to any coach looking to keep their name in good standings with their client base."
            2. _UtopiaS_, 25.06.2026, 3/5: "New update has rendered the app unstable. It crashes during workouts and the interaction with the watch app is now confusing and results in over-recording of calories. Please fix."
            3. _Tatitai_, 17.06.2026, 3/5: "Out of nowhere this app crashes and you don’t know when it will be back. It’s a great app for tracking and training. Cross information between Hevy, My fitness pal, Health app from iOS, iFitness. It would be 5/5 if it didn’t crash so often."
<!--/ir-theme-->
